description: Audits a set of inline SVG icons. Pass `icons` as markup containing one <svg> (or <symbol>) per icon. Reports mixed viewBox sizes, missing viewBox, non-square boxes, width and height ratios that disagree with the viewBox, mixed outline and solid styles, stroke widths and linecap or linejoin that vary, hard-coded colors instead of currentColor, icons neither aria-hidden nor named (WCAG 1.1.1), icons with both, ids repeated across icons, path points outside the viewBox, and icons that fill the artboard very differently from the median. Path extents use command endpoints only and only <path> data. Stroke and grid expectations are conventions. Static; nothing is rendered.
name: audit_icon_set
title: Icon set audit
